chunks: 1563 - Zurarah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
"The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله never prayed al-Ḍuḥā at all."
He said: So I said to him, "Did you not inform me that he عليه السلام used to pray four rakʿahs in the early part of the day?"
He said: "Yes. He used to count them as part of the eight that are after al-Ẓuhr."

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الثَّمَانِ: the eight rakʿahs of recommended prayer
key_terms.الضُّحَى: the forenoon prayer known as Duha
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurarah, the narrator transmitting from Imam Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام
key_terms.صَدْرِ النَّهَارِ: the early part of the day

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله pray the Duha prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله did not perform a distinct Duha prayer. The four rakʿahs prayed in the forenoon are explained by Imam Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام as being counted within the eight supererogatory rakʿahs associated with after al-Ẓuhr, clarifying the juristic classification of that prayer.
